question.question: What components and resource does the standard two-player Rival start with, what happens to the 2P Reshuffle card, and can its 10 VP trigger Endgame and victory?

key.expected_answer: Four cubes at Influence bottoms, three garrison troops rest supply, two Agents supply and third beside board, three Spies and one water supply, score/Combat zero. Retain Reshuffle in Hagal. Scoring Rival can trigger end at 10+ and win.
key.novelty: Rival full setup and scoring threat

a.answer: The Rival starts with four Influence cubes, 3 troops in garrison and 9 in supply, 2 Agents in supply and the third beside the board, 3 Spies, 1 water, and score and Combat markers at 0. Shuffle House Hagal and retain the 2P Reshuffle card. The Rival is a scoring competitor; its 10+ VP triggers Endgame at Recall and it can win.
a.evidence: Required Rival Rules: Setup; Rival starting components.

b.answer: The Rival starts with four Influence cubes, one at the bottom of each Faction track; three troops in its garrison and nine in supply; two Agents in supply and Swordmaster beside the board; three Spies and 1 water in supply; score and Combat markers at 0. Shuffle House Hagal and keep the 2P Reshuffle card in its deck. The Rival can trigger Endgame at 10 or more VP and can win by having the most VP.
b.evidence: Required Rival Rules: setup and starting components; Rival 10+ VP triggers Endgame.
